field.label: Keep run files for (days)
field.comment: Source files, export files and error reports of finished runs are removed after this many days.

field.label: Errors kept per run
field.comment: A run stores at most this many row errors. The run still counts all of them.

field.label: Time per cron pass (seconds)
field.comment: How long one pass of the OpenImport cron group may start new runs. A run that has started always finishes.

field.label: E-mail sender
field.comment: Sends the run e-mails and exports by e-mail. The addresses are set under Stores › Configuration › General › Store Email Addresses.

field.label: Private hosts allowed as URL sources
field.comment: One host name per line. Public hosts are always allowed. Addresses in private, loopback and link-local networks are refused unless their host is listed here.

field.label: Extra server folders for folder sources
field.comment: One absolute path per line. var/openimport is always allowed. Any other folder must be listed here.

field.label: Protect exports against spreadsheet formulas
field.comment: Cells that start with =, +, -, @, a tab or a line break get a leading apostrophe in CSV and XLSX exports, so a spreadsheet does not run them as formulas.

field.label: Safety limit for Replace and Delete (% of records)
field.comment: Runs that would replace or delete more than this share of an entity's records stop and wait for confirmation. Profiles can set their own limit.

group.label: Pictures from web addresses
group.comment: Product imports download pictures given as web addresses (base_image, small_image, thumbnail_image, swatch_image, additional_images and other image attributes) safely and keep them in var/import/images/openimport, so the next run only asks whether a picture changed.

field.label: Check for changed pictures after (hours)
field.comment: Until then a downloaded picture is used as it is. After that the next run asks the server whether it changed and downloads it only when it did. 0 = ask on every run.

field.label: Time per picture (seconds)
field.comment: A picture that takes longer counts as unreachable. 5 to 300.

field.label: Keep unused downloaded pictures for (days)
field.comment: Downloaded pictures no run used for this many days are removed from the picture cache. Pictures already in the catalog stay.
